text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Reviewers find the 338-hp ES 500e quicker and the 221-hp ES 350e more than sufficient, with the battery-electric versions feeling slightly smoother than the hybrid. Reviewers describe the ride as soft yet sturdy, with a little edge beneath the plush interior, despite no adaptive dampers. Reviewers describe the interior materials as upmarket. Reviewers highlight the standard 14-inch touchscreen running Lexus's next-generation software with customizable widgets and EV-specific tools.
